case_summary: Preserve the team that authorized each release signature despite later team changes, while leaving unsupported legacy history unknown.
answer: Add a nullable approving_team_id snapshot to releases and populate it in the existing signature write from the team context that authorized that signature. Update this read to use the snapshot; render NULL as unavailable/unknown. Do not backfill old rows from people.team_id: the case says no membership history or trustworthy historical log exists, so that would invent facts. Keep this field solely as historical display data; it must not grant current access. Evidence: REQUEST.md identifies the defect and forbids inventing old facts; FACTS.md confirms new signatures can capture context and past association grants no current access; schema.sql and read.sql show the current-team join causing the defect. Tradeoff: legacy releases remain unresolved until trustworthy evidence exists. Verify: (1) a new signature stores the authorizing team, (2) changing the signer's team afterward leaves the release's displayed team unchanged, (3) legacy NULL displays unknown, and (4) access checks do not consult the snapshot.
